name: Counter
description: A stepper for passengers, bags or any quantity. It holds no state of its own; the parent owns the value.

props.name: description
props.description: E.g. "Age 12+". The text comes from config. File A says children are 2–11; the Official seat-fee rule says 2–12.

props.name: min
props.description: The decrement button disables at this limit.

props.name: max
props.description: The increment button disables at this limit.

props.name: decrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the icon-only minus button, e.g. "Remove adult".

props.name: incrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the icon-only plus button, e.g. "Add adult".

states.name: at-max
states.visual: Plus disabled. Limits come from config, e.g. maximum total passengers or infants.

states.name: focus-visible
states.visual: Focus ring on the focused button.

requirements: A group (role="group", named by label) containing: a decrement Button, the value, an increment Button.
Buttons are named by decrementLabel / incrementLabel.
At a limit, the button is disabled and the reason is given in the description when it's a business rule, e.g. "Maximum 9 passengers per booking".
announcements: The value is in an aria-live="polite" element, so a change is announced: "2 adults".

rules: Buttons 40×40 (Button size sm, iconOnly minus / plus, ghost); value heading-3 with tabular numerals; row padding --space-3; divider between rows.

ambiguities.description: In tier-2-composites.md the decrementLabel / incrementLabel row is separated from the Counter prop table by a blank line, so Markdown renders it as a separate table. It is treated here as part of the prop table.
Child age band conflicts between sources (File A 2–11, Official seat rule 2–12); the description text must come from config.
